pipeline: Python＋新聞來源：發現重要新聞、取得來源、建立逐事件證據包
Gemini 第一輪：背景、影響機制、歷史比較、替代觀點、未來觀察
Python：逐項主張與來源驗證；數字、日期、引文、資料期間、未經證實的推論
Gemini 第二輪：刪除重複、補強邏輯、調整閱讀節奏、修正驗證問題
專業 XHTML／EPUB 3：共用已審定底稿，輸出速讀與深讀版

sections.name: Executive Brief
sections.description: 三件最重要的事情、整體國際局勢，以及今天與上一期相比真正改變的資訊。

sections.name: The World in Brief
sections.description: 晨報分兩層：10–12 則有足夠來源重點的主要新聞＋10–12 則不同事件的補充快訊，共 20–24 則；全球重大媒體頭條優先。來源不足不能用空白、重複、猜測或舊新聞湊數。夜報維持既有時長並以真實增量為準。

sections.name: Essential Analysis
sections.description: 晨報 4 篇不同事件的完整焦點分析；提供新增的背景、可核對證據、因果傳導、相反解釋及觀察重點，禁止重述第二章或人工拉長。夜報依實際增量與原核准時長執行。

sections.name: Deep Research
sections.description: Deep Research 晨報聚焦 1–2 篇與當天重大新聞相關的一手證據研究，需有原始文件、資料期間、歷史比較、機制、反方觀點、可推翻條件及來源對應；不能拿舊歷史研究冒充今日新專題。不到一篇合格研究維持 HOLD。

sections.name: What Changed & What to Watch
sections.description: 追蹤新證據、判斷變化、未來一週關鍵事件與必要的 Zinc Research Watch。

sections.name: Sources & Evidence
sections.description: 每則重要研究的來源、發布日期、數據期間與仍未核實事項。

editorial_selection.editorial_guardrails: Headline placement is a discovery and prioritization signal, never independent fact verification. Preserve original reporting, source dates, cross-checks, global diversity and human editorial signoff. Do not promote recycled headlines, sensationalism, marketing or owner industry bias.

inoreader_subscribed_news_owner_amendmen.policy: A genuine article identified through one of the owner's 24 imported Inoreader OPML public publisher RSS feeds, with original HTTPS article URL and publication timestamp inside the edition window, is qualified as SOURCE-ATTRIBUTED NEWS. A missing independently confirmed claim, opposing interpretation, or primary government statement may not veto the original subscribed news item.
inoreader_subscribed_news_owner_amendmen.source_boundary: Validate original OPML source ID, name and lane; 24 imported feed IDs only. Other free APIs are still supplemental and do not inherit automatic subscriber-news status. Deduplicate actual repeated events; keep time/URL/source safety controls.
inoreader_subscribed_news_owner_amendmen.content_boundary: If RSS contains only title, report the attributed linked title and do not manufacture a body, numerical claims, source quote or summarizing sentences. Where bounded publisher excerpt exists, only source-attributed, clearly reported content may be conveyed.
inoreader_subscribed_news_owner_amendmen.ai_analysis_boundary: Deeper causal mechanisms, independent factual assertions, disputes, rebuttals, forecasts, added numerical interpretations and Deep Research still require their own dated and attributable evidence. Opposing evidence belongs under Analysis/Alternative Views, not as grounds to reject the publisher's news.
inoreader_subscribed_news_owner_amendmen.approval_boundary: Subscribed-news qualification is NOT third-party fact certification or authorization to turn on Gemini, publication, EPUB, Pages or LINE; retain other G2 quality, timed-capture and owner release gates.

source_intake_hard_gate.name: G0_EVIDENCE_BEARING_UNIQUE_EVENTS_BEFORE_GEMINI_OR_PREVIEW
source_intake_hard_gate.explanation: A SHORTLIST SHORTAGE IS A SOURCE_CAPTURE_OR_SELECTION_PIPELINE_DEFECT, NEVER PROOF THAT GLOBAL NEWS IS SCARCE; OPML subscriber news attribution is not gated by the AI editor's agreement with the report.

sequential_improvements.name: SOURCE_AND_HARD_INPUT_GATE
sequential_improvements.deliverable: At least 20 deduplicated, dated, source-supported distinct candidate events; source failure classification and first-gate blocking

sequential_improvements.name: DEPTH_AND_EDITORIAL_PIPELINE
sequential_improvements.deliverable: 10–12 major articles, 10–12 briefs, 4 substantive analyses, 1–2 topical evidence-rich studies; 2 material Gemini edits and claim audit

sequential_improvements.name: ONE_COMPLETE_ACCEPTANCE
sequential_improvements.deliverable: Unified real-source P2 evidence, source and claim coverage, duplication check, measured reading time, HTML and EPUB technical checks; submit to owner only if all gates pass
